articles.title: The MAHA Movement Hits School Cafeterias: What It Means for Your Lunch
articles.summary: New federal dietary guidelines push schools to serve less processed food and more protein. But with tight budgets and rising costs, many districts are struggling to keep up.

articles.title: Poland Registers First Same-Sex Marriage After Landmark Court Rulings
articles.summary: Warsaw registered its first same-sex marriage on Thursday, following EU court rulings that Poland must recognize marriages performed abroad. The couple had wed in Germany.

articles.title: Iraq's New PM Ali al-Zaidi Sworn In with Partial Cabinet
articles.summary: Iraq's parliament approved Ali al-Zaidi as prime minister on Thursday, but only 14 of 23 ministers were confirmed. Key posts like interior and defense remain unfilled amid political wrangling.
